_comment: Oxford day trip from London. Primary sources only: National Rail Enquiries
journey planner, Chiltern Railways, Stagecoach Oxford Tube, Oxford Bus
Company, Oxfordshire County Council, the colleges' own visitor pages, the
Bodleian, the Ashmolean, the Pitt Rivers, the Museum of Natural History, the
University Church, the two punt stations and National Rail's Days Out Guide.
Every price was read off the operator's or venue's own page on the date in
checked. Train times and fares were sampled for Tuesday 15 September 2026 on
the National Rail journey planner, which is the only way to see a live fare.
NOT RECORDED because no primary source gave a figure: Christ Church guided
tour prices (only in the booking engine, released weekly), the Oxford Tube's
own end-to-end journey time (the operator publishes frequency, not duration),
the airline's fares, Oxford Castle and Prison admission (TLS handshake to
their site failed), and Oxford Botanic Garden admission.

train.source: https://ojp.nationalrail.co.uk/ (times and fares sampled for Tue 15 September 2026)

marylebone.toOxfordParkway: 1 h 11 m to 1 h 14 m direct

chilternOwnClaims.journeyTimeClaim: 'under an hour' - the 15 September 2026 timetable shows no Marylebone-Oxford service under 1 h 18 m

train.offPeakReturn: GBP 37.70 London Terminals to Oxford, any permitted route, so valid from either Paddington or Marylebone. Some itineraries price at GBP 43.70.

oxfordTube.frequency: up to every 10 minutes, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, no last coach
oxfordTube.booking: no need to pre-book, no peak or off-peak pricing

fares.dayTicket: GBP 28.00 adult, GBP 14.00 child, also valid on Stagecoach West local buses
fares.multiTrip12: GBP 63.00 child, GBP 113.40 student or senior

oxfordTube.journeyTime: the operator's own suggested day out allows 2 hours from a 07:45 Victoria departure; no end-to-end duration is published

airline.whatItIs: direct airport coach between Oxford or High Wycombe and Heathrow and Gatwick terminals, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Not a central London service.
airline.note: the GBP 3 park and ride combined ticket is not valid on the airline or the Oxford Tube

congestionCharge.appliesTo: cars and motorhomes (M1) only; electric cars are not exempt; vans, motorbikes and lorries pay nothing
congestionCharge.locations: six temporary charging locations, signed 280 yards ahead
congestionCharge.when: all year round including bank holidays
congestionCharge.payBy: midnight the day after passing a charge location
congestionCharge.ends: replaced by Oxford's traffic filter trial on Monday 28 September 2026

parkAndRide.combinedTicket: GBP 3 from 17 August 2026 to 31 March 2027: up to 16 hours' parking for one car plus return bus travel for up to five people of any age
parkAndRide.howToBuy: car park ticket machine or RingGo app, selecting the Parking & Bus option; show the ticket or active session to the driver both ways
parkAndRide.validOn: any Stagecoach, Oxford Bus Company or Thames Travel bus stopping within a park and ride site
parkAndRide.notValidOn: the airline and the Oxford Tube
parkAndRide.parkingOnlyThornhill: first hour free, up to 16 hours GBP 2.50, 16-24 hours GBP 4.50, 24-48 hours GBP 8.50

collegesThatCharge.name: Christ Church
collegesThatCharge.ticket: multimedia guide required and included in admission
collegesThatCharge.onTheDayMichaelmasTerm: 4 October to 12 December 2026: adult GBP 22.95 weekday, GBP 24.95 weekend; senior or student GBP 20.50 / GBP 22.50; child 5-17 GBP 17.50 / GBP 19.50
collegesThatCharge.onTheDayVacations: 2 September to 3 October and 13 to 31 December 2026: adult GBP 24.95 weekday, GBP 26.95 weekend; senior or student GBP 22.50 / GBP 24.50; child GBP 19.50 / GBP 21.50
collegesThatCharge.advanceSaving: GBP 2 per ticket booked online or at the Visitor Centre in advance
collegesThatCharge.under5: free with a paying adult, collected on the day, no multimedia guide
collegesThatCharge.carer: free carer ticket at the till with proof of entitlement
collegesThatCharge.release: tickets released each Friday at about 10am for the following week
collegesThatCharge.changes: non-refundable; free reschedule online up to two hours before with an account, otherwise GBP 2 per ticket
collegesThatCharge.hours: Mon-Sat from 10am, exit by 5pm; Sundays from 1.30pm (summer vacation) or 2pm (term)
collegesThatCharge.hallClosures: Great Hall closed Mon-Fri 12pm-2pm, and Saturdays 10.30am-2pm in Michaelmas term, for student meals; Sunday Hall opens 2pm; Saturdays the Cathedral closes 4.45pm for choir practice
collegesThatCharge.harryPotter: the college's own page says the Hall staircase in Bodley Tower, with 1638 fan vaulting, 'has been used in a number of film and television projects including Lewis and Harry Potter'. The Great Hall itself is the 1520s dining hall, not a film set.
collegesThatCharge.meadow: Christ Church Meadow is free all year except 25 December
collegesThatCharge.notRecorded: guided tour prices (40-minute college tour, 60-minute college and cathedral tour) are only shown in the weekly booking release

collegesThatCharge.name: Magdalen
collegesThatCharge.family: GBP 28.00, two adults and up to three children aged 7 or over
collegesThatCharge.jointWithBotanicGarden: GBP 17 adult, GBP 15 concession, one entry at each venue within 12 months
free: Oxford University, OUP or alumni card holders and one guest
collegesThatCharge.hours: every day 5 January to 21 December, 10am to dusk or 5pm, whichever is earlier; 6.30pm in July, August and September. Last admission 30 minutes before closing.
collegesThatCharge.notes: card payment only; the Hall may be closed over lunchtime

collegesThatCharge.name: New College
collegesThatCharge.family: GBP 32, two adults and up to three children aged 7 or over
free: Oxford City permanent residents with proof
Bodleian card holders and Oxford alumni plus one guest
collegesThatCharge.hoursSummer: 10 March to 31 October, 10am-5pm daily, last entry 4.30pm
collegesThatCharge.hoursWinter: 1 November to 9 March: Mondays closed entirely; Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri and Sun 1.30-4.30pm, last entry 4pm; Saturdays 10am-4.30pm or dusk
collegesThatCharge.notes: card only; advance booking only for groups of 10 or more

collegesThatCharge.name: Trinity
collegesThatCharge.notes: hours vary for private events; the college asks visitors to ring the Porter's Lodge on 01865 279900 before arriving

collegesThatCharge.name: Balliol
free: members of Oxford University and Oxford alumni
collegesThatCharge.open: gardens, Chapel and Hall; admission includes a free map and guide
collegesThatCharge.termRestriction: during term (weeks 0-9), summer exam periods and the admissions period, groups are limited to eight people including a guide; Green and Blue Badge guides may bring 19
collegesThatCharge.notes: phone 01865 277777 on the day to check it is open

collegesThatCharge.name: Merton
free: members of the University with up to four guests
collegesThatCharge.hours: Mon-Fri 2-5pm, Sat 10am-5pm, Sun noon-5pm, last admission 4.30pm
collegesThatCharge.closedAreas: the Hall, Fellows' Garden and residential areas are typically closed to all visitors, including alumni
collegesThatCharge.notes: card payments only at the Lodge

collegesFree.name: Lincoln
collegesFree.access: Front Quad and Chapel Quad; all chapel services including Evensong are open to the public
collegesFree.notes: phone or email the Porters' Lodge (01865 279800) to confirm the college is open that day; no large tour groups; closed two weeks over Christmas

collegesFree.name: Keble
collegesFree.notes: closed for college events at times; contact the Porters before planning a visit. Closed to the public 8 and 22 August 2026.

collegesFree.name: St John's
collegesFree.hours: daily 2-5pm in summer, until 4pm in winter
collegesFree.access: Front Quad, Canterbury Quad, the Chapel, Kendrew Quad and the gardens; Chapel open Thu-Tue 1.30-5pm, closed Wednesdays
collegesFree.notes: closed during University closure periods; the Great Lawn is closed for maintenance as of 1 July 2026, the Daisy Lawn stays open

collegesFree.name: Worcester
collegesFree.rule: tourists may visit only on an official tour led by a member of the Oxford Guild of Tour Guides, or by attending a public event
collegesFree.free: OX1 and OX2 residents, prospective applicants, University members and alumni card holders, 12.30pm-4pm seven days a week
collegesFree.notes: group sizes limited to six; closed to all visitors 12 September 2026

freeThings.name: Ashmolean Museum
freeThings.price: free, no booking for general admission
freeThings.ticketed: major exhibitions: In Bloom: How Plants Changed Our World; Aphrodite: The Making of a Goddess from 8 October 2026
freeThings.closures: four Level 3 Mezzanine Western Art galleries closed 1 June to mid-October 2026 - Sickert (63), Pissarro (65), Pre-Raphaelites (66), 19th Century Art (67). Turner's High Street and Millais's John Ruskin moved to Gallery 44 for the summer.

freeThings.name: Pitt Rivers Museum
freeThings.entrance: via the Museum of Natural History, Parks Road, OX1 3PW
freeThings.hours: Mondays 12-5pm (bank holiday and half-term Mondays 10-5), Tuesday to Sunday 10am-5pm
freeThings.note: opens at noon on Saturday 10 October 2026

freeThings.name: Oxford University Museum of Natural History
freeThings.note: audioguides in nine languages; five-minute walk from the Bodleian

freeThings.name: The Covered Market
freeThings.hours: Mon-Wed 8am-5.30pm, Thu-Sat 8am-10pm, Sun and bank holidays 10am-5pm
freeThings.note: over 50 independent shops, cafes and bars; individual traders' hours vary

freeThings.name: Bodleian Library
free: Blackwell Hall, the ground floor of the Weston Library - drop in, no ticket
the free exhibitions there: Pets & their People to 27 September 2026, Wonder of Birds to 3 January 2027
the Old Schools Quadrangle courtyard, whenever the gates are open

paid.divinitySchool: GBP 3 per person self-guided, 15 minutes - the infirmary in the Harry Potter films, in the Bodleian's own words
paid.tour30min: from GBP 12.50 - includes Duke Humfrey's Library
paid.radcliffeCameraAndCityTour: from GBP 30, Saturdays and Sundays - the only way inside the Radcliffe Camera

freeThings.closures: Divinity School closed all day 10 September 2026 and from 2pm on 11 September; free 10am-4pm on 13 September for Oxford Open Doors
freeThings.radcliffeCamera: exterior is free to look at in Radcliffe Square; inside only on the Radcliffe Camera tour

freeThings.name: University Church of St Mary the Virgin
freeThings.hours: Mon-Sat 9.30am-6pm, Sun noon-6pm, last tower admission 5.30pm
freeThings.climb: 127 steps up a medieval turret staircase, past the Clore Old Library and the bell ringing chamber; views over Radcliffe Square

punting.name: Magdalen Bridge Boathouse
punting.where: under Magdalen College tower, the lower end of the High Street
punting.selfHire: GBP 35 per hour, punts take up to 5 people
punting.chauffeured: GBP 50 per 30 minutes, up to 4 passengers, hand-crafted Oxford punts, picnic hamper available to pre-order
punting.season: 7 days a week, 1 February to 30 November, weather permitting
punting.booking: not required, but advisable on a busy weekend
punting.lateReturn: more than 5 minutes late adds 15 minutes' hire, and again at 20 minutes

punting.name: Cherwell Boathouse
punting.where: Bardwell Road, north Oxford, upstream of the University Parks
punting.selfHire: weekdays GBP 25 per hour or GBP 125 a day; weekends GBP 27 per hour or GBP 135 a day
punting.capacity: punts fit 6 - five seated plus a punter
punting.season: mid-March to mid-October, 10am until dusk, punt hire closes an hour before closing
punting.fleet: around 80 handmade boats, plus rowing boats and Canadian canoes; availability usually good midweek, weekends much busier
punting.nearby: about half an hour upstream to the Victoria Arms; downstream runs through the University Parks
